"3D game. Guide the ball through a maze and avoid it falling through the holes scattered throughout the maze. Using your phone to control the position of the maze. For example, tilting your phone one direction will cause the ball to roll left or right or up or down. With the speed based on how much you tilt.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
